freeze_boundary: Draft only. Materializes exactly the FP-001 requirement that a decision carries its reason AND source, the FP-002 precedence platform -> plan -> workspace -> business -> capability with a kill switch no narrower scope may override and historical read preserved when write is closed, the FP-003 requirement that a percentage decision shows its allocation, and the FP-005 requirement that a temporary flag has an expiry and an owner. The bucket allocation ALGORITHM (FP-003 'a workspace stays in the same bucket'), the circuit-state machine (FP-004) and the admin mutation API (FP-006) are NOT inferred here.
untestable_by_fixture: FP-003 requires allocation to be STABLE - the same workspace stays in the same bucket across evaluations - and FP-002 requires precedence to be deterministic across a scope hierarchy. Both are properties of an evaluator over repeated inputs, not of a single decision document, so fixtures cannot demonstrate them. They need an evaluator harness before freeze.
